title: 🏡 What actually happens before you get pre approved?
description:
🏡 What actually happens before you get pre approved?

It starts with a soft credit pull
No impact to your score
Just a quick look at your credit

Then we review your income and calculate your DTI

That’s how we determine what you can afford
And move you toward pre approval

If you’re military, a veteran, or planning to buy in Central Texas, we’re here to help.

📩 Send us a message to get started.
